summary: Jackson County, Mississippi, fire tower listed under the Mississippi Forest Service; the readable record covers a 1940 aircraft-warning test and a 1961 seedling pickup.

events.note: Part of an Aircraft Warning Service test; a telephone link to the tower failed
Notice said landowners could collect tree seedlings at the tower

evidence.supports: Jackson County, listed under the Mississippi Forest Service
May 1940 first Aircraft Warning Service test message sent from Pascagoula
evidence.quote: The first test message of the Aircraft Warning Service was sent from Pascagoula

evidence.supports: efforts to connect the Hilda tower to the telephone service failed
evidence.quote: after efforts failed to connect the Hilda fire tower with the central telephone service at Wiggins

evidence.supports: December 1961 area forester announced seedling delivery to Jackson County
evidence.quote: Area forester R. H. Miller said today the first shipment of forest tree seedlings will be delivered to Jackson County Wednesday

evidence.supports: landowners could pick up seedlings at the tower, four miles north of Gautier
evidence.quote: Landowners may pick up their seedlings at Hilda Fire Tower four miles north of Gautier between 1 and 4 p.m.

notes_for_editor: Thin. The only readable source is the Forest Lookouts page, which reprints two newspaper items (1940 and 1961). Build date, staffing, access and current status are not in any source the fetcher could read. Unverified leads, not cited: a 2012 Gulf Live article (gulflive.com/mississippi-press-living/2012/03/gautiers_hilda_fire_lookout_sy.html) returns 403 to the fetcher, and a search snippet from it says the tower remains standing on the east side of Gautier-Vancleave Road just south of I-10. A search snippet from a Facebook post gives a probable 1933-1942 Civilian Conservation Corps build date. The 1961 notice places the tower four miles north of Gautier, which does not obviously match the 'just south of I-10' location, so verify the site before publishing. The NHLR Mississippi list does not include Hilda.
